# BrakeSense

> Forward-collision warning for iPhone. BrakeSense is a driver aid: the phone's rear camera watches the car ahead, and the app says "Brake" out loud when the gap starts closing too fast. Collision warnings are free; Premium is an optional subscription with extra alerts.

## Key facts
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later. Android is planned.
- Status: coming soon to the App Store.
- Made by Harrison and Nick. It started as their team's project at Hacklanta 2026.
- Free: collision warnings with a spoken alert, directions on the camera view, trip recaps, saved clips, crash check-in with emergency contacts.
- Premium (optional subscription): traffic start, lane departure, cut-in and green light alerts, deeper trip insights, a compact directions banner.
- Privacy: car detection runs on the phone, video stays on the phone, and the app has no ads or trackers. Only emergency contacts use a server.
- Limits: BrakeSense warns; it doesn't brake or steer. It can miss cars in glare, rain, fog or darkness. It has not been independently tested.
